name: bootstrap_flow
description: Recommended local bootstrap sequence for reproducing the project with seeded data, TMDB enrichment, trailer sync and poster cache.

steps.purpose: Apply Django migrations and create database schema.
Import MovieLens 100K movies, genres, synthetic users and ratings.
Enrich movies with TMDB metadata and save poster_url.
Fetch trailer URLs and trailer site values.
Generate short demo reviews for ratings.
Fill demo profile data for existing users.

steps.command: python manage.py create_admin admin1 --password test12345 --email admin1@example.com --activate
steps.purpose: Create a staff admin account for management and demo.
Download poster files from poster_url into local media storage.
